common.description: Sales performance by market, product and period, with an AI assistant that shows its sources.

errors.timeout: The request took too long. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server: The server couldn't complete the request.
errors.invalidData: We received data in an unexpected format.
errors.dataFailed: The dashboard data couldn't load. Each section has a Try again button.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: We'll reconnect automatically. Everything on this page is kept.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: This page couldn't be displayed. Try again or go back to the dashboard.

composer.label: Ask about the data
composer.blankReason: Type a question to send it.
composer.tooLongReason: Questions can be up to {max} characters.

empty.title: Ask about the portfolio
empty.body: Answers come from the AI and may be incomplete. Each answer shows its sources and the matching data, so you can check it.

answer.label: AI answer · may be incomplete
answer.pending: Sources and confidence appear when the answer is complete.

stopped.title: Stopped — answer incomplete.
stopped.body: No sources or confidence for a partial answer.

abstain.title: I can't answer this from the data

declined.englishOnly: I only understand English. Please ask your question in English.

actions.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text instead.

dataCheck.title: What the data shows
dataCheck.name: Scope
dataCheck.attention: {needAttention, plural, one {# of {markets} markets needs} other {# of {markets} markets need}} attention; the answer names {named}.
dataCheck.attentionRegion: {needAttention, plural, one {# of {markets} markets in {region} needs} other {# of {markets} markets in {region} need}} attention; the answer names {named}.
dataCheck.gapNote: {count, plural, one {# market not mentioned} other {# markets not mentioned}}
dataCheck.statusNote: Status is set for the latest month only.

shell.newAnswers: {count, plural, one {# new answer} other {# new answers}}

overview.summary: {markets, plural, one {# market} other {# markets}} · {products, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} · latest data {period}

kpi.title: Key figures
kpi.latestOnly: Status is set for the latest month only.
kpi.perProduct: Status is set per market, not per product.

formula.revenue: sum of monthly actual revenue over the selected months.
formula.attainment: actual ÷ forecast over the selected months; can differ from a market's stored figure by about 1 point.
formula.growth: actual ÷ prior-year actual over the selected months, minus 100%.

marketStatus.title: Market status
marketStatus.latestOnly: Status is set for the latest month only; tiles show forecast attainment.
marketStatus.caption: Market status by region, {window}

notice.statusLatestOnly: Status is set for the latest month only; the map shows forecast attainment.
notice.shareLatestOnly: Market share is set for the latest month only; the map shows forecast attainment.
notice.sharePerProduct: Market share is not set per product; the map shows forecast attainment.

marketStatus.perProduct: Values are for {product}; status is set per market.
marketStatus.hintPointer: Shift+click a market to add it to the table filter.
marketStatus.hintTouch: Tap a market, then Add to filter.

topRisks.title: Top risks
topRisks.order: Off track first, then by attainment

trend.title: Revenue · {from} – {to}
trend.summary: Revenue for {scope}, {from} to {to}. {period}: actual {actual}, forecast {forecast}, prior year {priorYear}.
trend.caption: Revenue by month for {scope}
trend.name: Revenue trend

marketsTable.title: Markets
marketsTable.caption: Markets in {scope}, {window}. Column headers sort the table.
marketsTable.totalCalculated: Total of the rows shown, calculated from monthly data
marketsTable.empty: None of the selected markets is in this view. Clear the selection to see every market.
marketsTable.noteLatest: Status and share are set for the latest month only.
marketsTable.notePerProduct: Share is not available per product.
marketsTable.noteCalculated: All figures are calculated from monthly data, so a row adds up and the total is the sum of the rows. Share and status are the stored latest-month figures; the tiles show stored KPIs, which can differ by about 1 point.

heatMap.title: Heat map
heatMap.subtitle: {metric} by month

notice.statusPerMonth: Status is set for the latest month only; the heat map shows growth YoY.
notice.sharePerMonth: Market share is set for the latest month only; the heat map shows growth YoY.

heatMap.pick: Pick a cell to see its value.
heatMap.hint: Arrow keys move, Enter opens the market at that month, Shift+click or Shift+Enter selects it.
heatMap.caption: {metric} by month for {scope}
heatMap.noteCalculated: Calculated from monthly series: values can differ from the stored KPIs by about a point.

exportMarkets.title: Rows as shown
exportMarkets.csvHint: Raw numbers in USD, for other tools
exportMarkets.failed: Couldn't create the file. Try again.

about.calculatedValue: Calculated from monthly data (revenue = Σ actual, attainment = Σ actual ÷ Σ forecast, growth = Σ actual ÷ Σ prior year − 1); share and status as stored for the latest month. Totals follow the Excel filter.
about.statusValue: Set in the data for the latest month only.
